┌─ Help: Logs and replay ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Logs and replay                                                              │
│   Ctrl+L            your sessions, and the server's log of them              │
│   Enter             replay the session in place (Left, Right step; Home, End │
│                     jump; Esc comes back)                                    │
│   R, E              read the server's log of one; export one to a file       │
│   V                 the log, short or all: routine movement and rules ticks  │
│                                                                              │
│   Every session is recorded by default, under its id, in seq-tui/sessions in │
│   your data dir (-log-dir moves it, -no-record turns it off). A log never    │
│   holds your credential.                                                     │
│   seq-tui -replay FILE (or a session id) draws a recording with no server;   │
│   -text prints it as plain text.                                             │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │

│ Page 6 of 10  ? next page  Left, Right turn  Esc closes                      │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
